title: A shared vector index queried without a tenant filter, where deleted documents are only marked

planted.why: the query ignores the tenant: the top hits come from every customer's documents, so one customer's question can be answered from another's files
a deleted document is only flagged and the query never checks the flag, so it is retrieved and quoted until the nightly job runs

proof.python:
import rag
rag.ingest('acme', 'a1', [1, 0], 'acme salary bands')
rag.ingest('globex', 'g1', [0.9, 0.1], 'globex layoff plan')
seen = []
rag.answer(lambda p: seen.append(p) or 'x', lambda q: [0.9, 0.1], 'acme', 'q')
assert 'globex layoff plan' in seen[0], 'another tenant document was retrieved'
rag.delete('acme', 'a1')
seen.clear()
rag.answer(lambda p: seen.append(p) or 'x', lambda q: [1, 0], 'acme', 'q')
assert 'acme salary bands' in seen[0], 'a deleted document was retrieved'
